items.text: I have suffered the very issue you mentioned, with a random, sudden smell that comes wafting into my (condo building) bathroom; periodically even when I've done NOTHING recent in there to cause it. All while a few moments previously, the scent was normal!🤷‍♀️  I've tried multiple bowl & tank cleaning tricks, & deodorizing products.  The bowl seal doesn't feel loose on the floor.  And the (high turnover) maintenance crew here has insisted (for years) that I just need to flush more, or run the sink & tub water more. I DO use the water regularly!  But I've lived here a LONG time, & it didn't ALWAYS smell like a mystery series of stink bomb attacks in there!  I've been suspicious of something like this.  But I've never had a plumber check it out;  or had anyone else validate, that perhaps some gas backup is coming from outside, perhaps through the vent?!  The building is quite old, built in 1963 I think.  So the pipe flow systems, as well as their occasional modern fixes, could very easily have resulted in some backfiring fumes. Meanwhile, I've bought MULTIPLE cleaning agents trying to combat this. As though it all came from me, & my tank, my bowl, & or my drains!😳  So THIS is all very refreshing information!!!
